files.name: motion-prompt-083.txt
PROMPT.md
files.content:
Please use "Cursor follower" (マウスストーカー), one of the names in "Landing page & web effects".
Motion Prompt #083

What it is: A shape trails the mouse pointer with a delay
What the sample shows: As the cursor moves around the page, an orange circle follows it a little behind.
Spec:
- Cursor path: x = 255 + 175·sin(2πt/4.8), y = 86 + 46·sin(4πt/4.8) (a figure eight lying on its side, one lap per 4.8 s).
- Circle: radius 17, orange, opacity 0.88, drawn under the cursor.
- Follow rule: every frame (60 fps) it covers 12% of the remaining distance (x += (cursor x − x) × 0.12).
- The arrow cursor stays visible.
When to use it: Use it on brand sites and portfolios to add a playful, hands-on feel.

Reference implementation (Canvas 2D, a function whose picture depends only on the time): https://showheyohtaki.github.io/motion-prompt/api/v1/en/e/083.txt
Shared helper code: https://showheyohtaki.github.io/motion-prompt/api/v1/kit/lp.js
Keep the shapes, timing and easing values of the reference implementation as they are, and change only the text, colours and assets to fit what I am making.
